questions.q: How should a date value be written in a SOQL WHERE clause?
options: In MM/DD/YYYY format inside double quotes
Unquoted, in YYYY-MM-DD format, such as CloseDate >= 2026-01-01
In single quotes, such as CloseDate >= '2026-01-01'
As a text string wrapped in DATE()
questions.explain: Date and datetime values are never quoted in SOQL. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and datetimes use YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of a date literal like LAST_N_DAYS:30 over a hard-coded date?
options: It runs faster than any other filter
It returns records from all time zones combined
It works only on custom objects
It is resolved against the current date every time the query runs, so it never goes stale
questions.explain: Date literals are keywords Salesforce resolves at run time, so the same query always covers the right relative period.

questions.q: Which query returns one row of closed-won revenue per calendar year?
options: SELECT YEAR(CloseDate), SUM(Amount) FROM Opportunity GROUP BY CloseDate
SELECT CloseDate, SUM(Amount) FROM Opportunity
SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM Opportunity WHERE CALENDAR_YEAR = 2026
SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate), SUM(Amount) FROM Opportunity WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won' GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate)
questions.explain: A date function such as CALENDAR_YEAR() can be grouped on, combining the grouping from Lesson 8 with date parts.

questions.q: When grouping revenue by fiscal quarter over several years, why include FISCAL_YEAR as well as FISCAL_QUARTER?
options: FISCAL_QUARTER cannot be used in GROUP BY
SOQL requires two date functions in every query
FISCAL_YEAR converts the time zone
Otherwise quarter 1 of every year merges into one group
questions.explain: FISCAL_QUARTER returns only the quarter number, so without the year, matching quarters from different years combine.

questions.q: What does convertTimezone() do when used with a datetime field such as CreatedDate?
options: Changes the org's fiscal year
Converts the value to the running user's time zone before a date function is applied
Removes the time portion permanently from the record
Converts the field to a text string
questions.explain: Datetime fields are stored in UTC. Wrapping them in convertTimezone() makes date boundaries follow the user's time zone, as in CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)).
